intro.title: Build todo CRUD REST API
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a todo CRUD REST API using Node.js. You will learn how to create, read, update, and delete todo items through HTTP endpoints. The core programming concepts involve handling HTTP requests, managing data in memory, and structuring a simple server with routes. You'll use key Node.js constructs like the built-in 'http' module and basic JavaScript objects to implement the API logic.
intro.usecase: This pattern is the foundation of countless interactive web and mobile applications. For example, any task management app like Asana or Todoist uses a todo CRUD API to let users create, view, update, and delete their tasks, syncing these changes across all devices. As a developer, you'll implement similar APIs for features like user profiles in social apps, product listings in e-commerce backends, or content management in publishing tools, where persistent data operations are essential.
